About Strategy at CarMax
CarMax operates one of the most complex retail and supply chain operations in the country as we sell over a million vehicles to our retail and wholesale customers a year, while serving millions of customers across 250+ locations and digital channels. Our Strategy teams tackle the key questions that define our business: Which vehicles should we acquire and from what channels? How do we efficiently move and recondition millions of cars? How do we allocate inventory across our network? How do we create seamless omnichannel experiences as customers shop online, via phone, and in stores? Our analysts partner closely with Product, Technology, and Operations leaders to answer these questions, driving both operational excellence and strategic innovation.

- Contribute to our Community - Join a vibrant community of over 200 full-time analysts from diverse backgrounds. Build friendships and professional relationships that will enrich your experience and contribute to your future success.

- Do the Right Thing:  We uphold a culture of integrity, promoting a respectful and inclusive work environment.
- Put People First:  We prioritize associate development, healthy work culture & ensuring a great experience for our customers.
- Win Together:  Teamwork is key; we learn from each other and value diverse perspectives.
- Go for Greatness:  We strive for continuous improvement, enhancing our skills and the products we create & solidifying CarMax’s industry leadership.

- Practical experience (coursework, projects, research, internships)

- Proactivity and commitment to delivering results

About This Job
The Senior Program Manager at CarMax Auto Finance is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional business and technology initiatives that require strong problem-solving, operational understanding, and technology fluency. This role partners with business leaders, Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Risk, Learning, Communications, and other stakeholders to understand business problems, evaluate solution options, and drive work from discovery through implementation.
This role goes beyond coordinating work or managing project plans. The Senior Program Manager takes ownership of ambiguous problems, asks effective questions, examines how processes and systems work together, and helps teams identify practical paths forward. The role evaluates whether a need may be addressed through process redesign, automation, reporting or data improvements, AI-enabled capabilities, technology enhancements, or a combination of solutions.
The Senior Program Manager develops a strong understanding of CAF processes, systems, data flows, integrations, controls, and operational workflows. While not responsible for detailed requirements or technical design, this role brings enough business and technical fluency to shape solution options, evaluate tradeoffs, recognize cross-functional impacts, and connect business needs with Technology capabilities.

Own complex, ambiguous cross-functional initiatives by clarifying the business problem, intended outcomes, customer and associate impacts, operational context, and key constraints. - Significant regulatory, financial, customer, operational, or reputational risk
- Complex sequencing and resource conflicts

- CAF-wide or enterprise impact
- Executive governance and visibility
- Limited precedent or an undefined delivery path
- A need to establish the program structure and governance model
